title: Export Failure Routing result
description: Closed, versioned runtime contract for the export failure routing evaluator (SCRUM-237, M5_REPLAY_SAFE). The typed result is the only PASS signal; it never grants repository, PR, merge, deploy or release authority.

task_id.description: Governed task identity that produced this routing result.

source_sha.description: Source snapshot commit SHA the routing decision was produced from.

idempotency_key.description: Replay identity. Same key + same decision_digest is an idempotent replay.

decision_digest.description: Canonical semantic digest of the routing input.

retry_count.description: How many retries have already been attempted for this evidence key.

retry_deadline_seconds.description: Maximum seconds a bounded retry may span. Null when route is not BOUNDED_RETRY.

prohibited_actions.description: Actions explicitly prohibited by this route decision.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of the routing decision.
